T-2388: integrate current dev, re-derive the generated files

`dev` advanced to a3a87caf while this branch waited — the occupied-transport
work of PR #1649 (T-3088/T-2793/T-2804), T-3366's verandah rail, and two
changelog folds. Merged in with no hand-resolved geometry, record or
manifest row.

Two conflicts, both GENERATED, both taken as dev's file and then rebuilt from
the merged tree rather than edited:

* `data/liberties.json`      → `tools/compile_liberties.py`  (992 liberties)
* `docs/measurements/source_use_coverage.md`
                             → `tools/compile_source_use.py` (559 sources,
                               all source IDs resolve)

`tools/compile_scene.py --all` then reported no further change, so the
sidecar indices were already consistent with the merged tree.

The two asset registries auto-merged and were audited row by row rather than
trusted: of 1,034 rows, dev changed 52 and this branch 25, the two sets do not
intersect, every one of dev's 52 is dev's value in the merge and every one of
this branch's 25 is this branch's. No foreign registry row was touched. The
blockhouse master stays at the natively rebuilt 133,092 B / `96d9fb80…`.

Dev changed no `fort_structure` producer, no shared archetype this family
reads and not `generators/blender.pin`, so the 25-master native rebuild
already proved on this branch still applies byte for byte — `validate.py
--stale` in the gate is what holds that claim, not this message.

The three append-only docs merged with both sides' blocks intact
(`L-second-fort-blockhouse-cupola-2388` beside dev's eight new liberties).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

T-2388: file this head's own both-viewport smoke readings

The two legs `tools/smoke_budget.mjs --for-diff` prices for this diff, run in
the foreground on the merged head's published mirror (sha256:02b6b084…):

* `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=desktop SMOKE_STAGE=3`  — SMOKE PASS, 107 passed, 0 failed,
  zero page errors, 4 m 08 s at 1280x800
* `SMOKE_VIEWPORT=mobile SMOKE_STAGE=3-4` — SMOKE PASS, 139 passed, 0 failed,
  zero page errors, 4 m 20 s at 390x780

`--for-diff` names parts 1-15 because the asset registries moved, which is the
whole gate rather than a reading of this diff; part 3 is the part that actually
covers what changed (the record's own account on the card, the citation to its
document, the liberties). The whole 15-part gate was NOT run here and is not
claimed — the repository's own hosted eight-part gate is what this merges on.

A reading filed before any of those is labelled in the OLD numbering of its day.
